remarks: *HIGHEST & BEST by Noon, Tuesday, 6/25* Welcome to Winnipauck Village, one of Norwalk's most reputable and well-run complexes. Enter this turn-key unit through the front door and head straight into the eat-in kitchen, which is in great condition and has everything a homeowner may need. Past the kitchen find a conveniently located half bath, perfect for guests. Head into the living room/dining room area and enjoy this large multi-purpose space, complete with a fire place and a sliding door to the private, serene back deck space. Up the stairs you will find two generous bedrooms. The primary bedroom in the back is complete with an en suite bath and ample closet space. This floor also has laundry and an additional hallway full bathroom to round out this incredible unit. Don't miss the two in-ground complex pools or the brand new pickleball courts, as well as all the other great amenities this complex has to offer. All of this, centrally located in Norwalk close to shopping, the brand new West Rocks field, which is just up the street, some of Norwalk's best restaurants less than a mile away and I-95 and the Merritt right around the corner. Don't miss this opportunity-schedule a viewing before it's gone!
